title: Chicago House Music Knowledge Graph — Specialist Dataset, 1977–1995
description: An evidence-graded dataset of Chicago house music, 1977-1995: 18 venues, 115 artists, 16 labels, 46 recordings (45 Discogs-verified), 156 network relationships, and a 368-claim evidence register in which every claim carries a CTL grade (Verified 154 / Supported 116 / Provisional 50 / Disputed 28 / Unresolved 20). Photo manifest: 49 Wikimedia Commons candidates, all UNVERIFIED — not cleared for use. Venue coordinates are blank by design; none are asserted.
notes: Pre-publication package (v1.0 assembled 2026-11-16 from v0.1 staged, 2026-11-14). Zenodo deposit pending the founder's token sitting; no DOI yet. Staged v0.1 counted 852 rows including 34 fully blank rows in network_edges; the v1.0 package removes them (logged in CHANGELOG), for 818 data rows and 156 edges.
